headline: This pilgrimage route explains why so many foreigners are affected by the flood disaster in Nepal
lead: Nepal-China border crossing: Flood-affected, international pilgrimage route to Tibet, and key regional trade artery
seo_title: This pilgrimage route explains why so many foreigners are affected by the flood disaster in Nepal
social_title: Flood disaster in Nepal: Why so many foreigners are affected
print_title: Floods and trade: The double tragedy at the border crossing
print_subtitle: The flood disaster in Nepal affects pilgrimage route and trade route
summary_bullets_en: The flood disaster in Nepal affected a border crossing between Nepal and China, which serves as both an international pilgrimage route to Tibet and a significant trade route.
Many foreigners were impacted because this route is vital for regional goods imports and international pilgrimages.
key_questions_de: Warum ist der Grenzübergang zwischen Nepal und China so bedeutend?

Welche Rolle spielt der Handelsweg für die Region?
